snippet.title: Poker Show VR
snippet.description:
Poker Show VR is an entertaining VR poker game featuring classic five card draw poker meets real-life fashion models as opponents.
Now Available on Steam!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/610350/Poker_Show_VR/
